{
  "name": "lenadweb-image-preview",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Previews the image in the clipboard and the images pasted into the prompt, drawn above the prompt in any terminal",
  "author": {
    "name": "lenadweb",
    "url": "https://github.com/lenadweb"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "icon": "./icon.png",
  "repository": "https://github.com/lenadweb/claude-code-plugins",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/lenadweb/claude-code-plugins/tree/main/plugins/lenadweb-image-preview",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/lenadweb/claude-code-plugins/tree/main/plugins/lenadweb-image-preview#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/lenadweb/claude-code-plugins/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/lenadweb/claude-code-plugins/blob/main/plugins/lenadweb-image-preview/PRIVACY.md",
  "keywords": [
    "images",
    "clipboard",
    "preview",
    "terminal",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "pixel_images": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Real pixels (Ghostty, kitty)",
      "description": "Draw images with real pixels through the kitty graphics protocol. Turn on only in Ghostty or kitty; other terminals show block characters.",
      "default": false
    }
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
